cover: UN: people pushed into ever smaller areas
Novaya Gazeta says it is forced to close
Supreme Court upholds Khurram Parvez's bail

stories.label: World · Life & safety
stories.head: Commanders linked to rape
bullets: A UK open-source group, the Centre for Information Resilience, names 25 RSF, army and allied commanders.
It says they were directly or indirectly responsible for sexual violence at five sites, including El Fasher.
Neither force responded to Al Jazeera; both have denied such abuses.

stories.label: World · Life & safety · Shelter
stories.head: Displacement 'acute and chronic'
bullets: The UN rights office says Israeli military zones are expanding west, pushing people into smaller areas.
A 25 October drone strike and fire at tents in Al Shujaiyeh displaced about 800 people.
Israel has said it aims to deploy across 70% of Gaza; no Israeli comment was reported.

stories.label: World · Press freedom
stories.head: An independent paper shuts
bullets: Novaya Gazeta says authorities and security services forced it to close, and that it was evicted from its office.
UN rights chief Volker Türk called it a devastating blow to independent media.

stories.label: India · Due process
stories.head: Bail stands for Khurram Parvez
bullets: The Supreme Court dismissed the NIA's challenge to bail for the Kashmiri activist in a UAPA case.
It cited his long incarceration since his arrest in November 2021.
The NIA's arguments were not reported.
